scene_detection.method: FFmpeg scale=320:-1,select=gt(scene,0.25); candidates, not validated cuts or all visual changes

host_main_visual_sampling.meaning: Manual review of sampled frames; includes host with overlays, excludes circular PIP; not exact screen-time
